paragraphs.text: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin for comprehensive arXiv literature search, with Jev-powered AI screeni
ng and classification.
Comprehensive arXiv literature search for your agent, on a local corpus.

Quick start ·
Usage ·
Development ·
Try online
English · 简体中文
**Parallax is a DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin for finding the arXiv papers on a topic from a local c
orpus.** It harvests arXiv metadata into SQLite. The agent then searches it with set operations (key
word recall, union, subtract, AI screening and classification), and each intermediate set shows up i
n the dsh sidebar, where you can open it.
A typical graph: recall routes → merge → AI screening → AI classification. The semantic-search route
s shown here are from Parallax online; this plugin recalls by keyword.
A general-purpose agent searches the open web through a black-box search API: it sees only the top-k
results, can't tell you how many papers a topic really has, and spends effort cleaning up noise. Pa
rallax works the other way round. The agent recalls exhaustively from a corpus with known boundaries
, keeps every intermediate result as a set you can inspect, and leaves per-paper judgement to Jev, a
judge model that returns calibrated probabilities rather than free-text verdicts.
- **Local arXiv corpus**: harvest the categories you care about day by day, with a coverage calendar

that shows exactly which days are in.
- **Auditable set graph**: every step is an immutable node, s

o you can see what each one kept, what it dropped, and why.
- **AI screening and classification**: J
ev judges thousands of papers in minutes, trialled on a sample first, and never pays twice for the s

ame paper.
- **A research skill included**: a literature-search playbook for reading lists, surveys,
method and trend searches, loaded only when needed.
The corpus, the graphs and every judgement stay in a SQLite file on your machine.
## How it works
Searching papers is not like ranking a feed, and a recall → coarse filter → fine filter funnel isn't
g papers is not like ranking a feed, and a recall → coarse filter → fine filter funnel isn't enough:
- **It needs several recall routes.** A topic goes by several names, each name becomes one keyword r

oute, and the routes have to be merged and deduplicated.
- **It needs review and repair.** Human or
agent, the first pass misses things. Review has to be able to drop false positives in bulk and add b
ack what was missed.
Merging, deduplicating and removing are set operations. So in Parallax the unit the agent works with
is a **set of papers**, and every set is an immutable node in a graph:
- **Corpus root**: a virtual starting point (a category scope or date range of the local corpus), so

the whole library never has to be materialized as a set.
- **Rule filter**: filters by arXiv catego

ry, submission date, or keywords in title, abstract or authors (substring or whole-word).
- **Named

list**: arXiv ids listed by hand, for papers you already know or ones the review found missing.
- **

Union / subtract**: merges recall routes, and removes false positives.
- **AI screening**: the agent
turns your intent into inclusion and exclusion criteria, and Jev gives each paper a probability of

inclusion (kept at p ≥ 0.5 by default).
- **AI classification**: splits a screened set into 2–12 cla
sses, single-label or multi-label (a paper can belong to two classes).
Screening is where a plain LLM gets slow and expensive: it has to write a verdict for every paper, a
nd long batches of structured output break easily. Jev answers typed questions with probabilities di
rectly, so it is both faster and cheaper:
Screening 10,000 papers: about 2 minutes with Jev versus about 20 with a general LLM (LLM time estim
ated from a 1,000-paper benchmark).
The graph is drawn live in the **Build graph** tab of the right sidebar. Click any node to see which
papers it kept, which it excluded, and the probability behind each judgement.
[该节后续省略]
## Plugin or online?
This plugin is the local, open-source edition of Parallax. Parallax online runs the same set-graph s
earch with a larger corpus and more of the work around it:
| | This plugin | Parallax online |
| **Corpus** | The categories and days you harvest yourself | All arXiv subjects since 2020, ready t

o search |
| **Recall** | Keyword, category, date | Keyword, category, date, and semantic search |
|

**Screening and classification** | Jev, with your own API key | Jev |
[该节后续省略]
### Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness with a profile that includes the web UI (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app`)
- Node.js ≥

22.5 (the plugin uses the built-in `node:sqlite`, so there is no native module to compile)
- A Jev A
PI key for AI screening and classification (optional: rule filters and set operations work without o
key for AI screening and classification (optional: rule filters and set operations work without one)
## Data, cost and privacy
- **Your data stays local.** The corpus, graphs and judgements are in `$DSH_HOME/storages/parallax.d

b` (`~/.dsh` by default).
- **Only two hosts are contacted.** Harvests go to `oaipmh.arxiv.org`, at
least 4 seconds apart as arXiv asks. AI screening and classification go to the Jev endpoint you conf
igure, and send only each paper's title, abstract, authors, date and categories, plus your criteria.
- **Each judgement is paid for once.** Jev judgements are stored per paper; after a failure, a canc

el or a restart, resuming only judges papers that have no judgement yet.
- **The key stays out of th
e database.** The dsh credential service holds the Jev API key; the `PARALLAX_JEV_API_KEY` environme
nt variable works too.
## Limitations
- The corpus has arXiv **metadata and abstracts** only: no full text, no citation graph, no embeddin
gs. Recall is by keyword, so the agent covers the different names of a concept with separate routes.

Semantic recall is available in Parallax online.
- The local corpus holds only the dates and catego
ries you harvested; it is not all of arXiv (Parallax online comes with all of arXiv since 2020). And
arXiv's OAI interface serves records by **datestamp** (the date of the last metadata change), not b
y submission date: a revised paper moves to a later date. So the agent treats only an **unbroken run

** of fully harvested days as complete coverage, and says so when gaps could change its answer.
- Je
v returns probabilities, not reasons, and is billed per request. The skill has the agent run a trial
before a full run, and read the abstracts of borderline papers itself.

limitations: 本地语料仅包含已采集的 arXiv 元数据与摘要，不含论文全文、引文图或嵌入向量。
召回依赖关键词，不同概念名称需分别建立检索路径。
仅连续完整采集的日期范围被视为完整覆盖，采集缺口可能影响结果。
Jev 返回纳入概率而非判断理由，并按请求计费；边界论文需自行阅读摘要复核。
README所列筛选耗时为基于千篇基准的估算，并非保证。
